{{short description|none}} {{Use mdy dates|date=October 2021}} {{use American English|date=October 2021}} {{Infobox election | election_name = 2022 United States House of Representatives election in South Dakota, at-large district | country = South Dakota | type = presidential | ongoing = yes | previous_election = 2020 United States House of Representatives election in South Dakota | previous_year = 2020 | next_election = 2024 United States House of Representatives election in South Dakota | next_year = 2024 | election_date = November 8, 2022 | image_size = x150px | image1 = [[File:Dusty Johnson - 117th Congress.jpg|x150px]] | nominee1 = [[Dusty Johnson]] | party1 = Republican Party (United States) | popular_vote1 = | percentage1 = | image2 = [[File:No image.svg|x120px]] | nominee2 = Collin Duprel | party2 = Libertarian Party (United States) | popular_vote2 = | percentage2 = | map_image = | map_size = | map_caption = | title = U.S. Representative | before_election = [[Dusty Johnson]] | before_party = Republican Party (United States) | after_election = | after_party = }} {{Elections in South Dakota}} The '''2022 United States House of Representatives election in South Dakota''' will be held on November 8, 2022, to elect the [[United States House of Representatives|U.S. Representative]] from {{ushr|SD|AL}}. The election will coincide with [[2022 United States House of Representatives elections|other elections]] to the House of Representatives, [[2022 United States Senate elections|elections]] to the [[United States Senate]] and various [[2022 United States elections|state and local elections]]. Incumbent Republican [[Dusty Johnson]] was re-elected with 81.0% of the vote in [[2020 United States House of Representatives election in South Dakota|2020]].{{cite web |title=General Election - November 3, 2020 |url=https://sdsos.gov/elections-voting/assets/2020GeneralStateCanvassFinal&Certificate.pdf |work=[[Secretary of State of South Dakota]] |date=November 10, 2020 |access-date=November 12, 2020}} Johnson defeated state representative [[Taffy Howard]] in the Republican primary. His only general election opponent is [[Libertarian Party (United States)|Libertarian]] Collin Duprel. {{toclimit|2}} ==Republican primary== ===Candidates=== ====Nominee==== *[[Dusty Johnson]], incumbent U.S. Representative{{Cite news|last=Lawrence|first=Tom|date=August 23, 2021|title=2022 draws closer, and South Dakota Democrats still need to find and field candidates in state, national races|work=The South Dakota Standard|url=https://www.sdstandardnow.com/home/2022-draws-closer-and-sd-democrats-still-need-to-find-and-field-candidates-in-state-national-races|url-status=live|access-date=August 28, 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210824135152/https://www.sdstandardnow.com/home/2022-draws-closer-and-sd-democrats-still-need-to-find-and-field-candidates-in-state-national-races|archive-date=August 24, 2021}} ====Eliminated in primary==== *[[Taffy Howard]], [[South Dakota House of Representatives|state representative]] from the 33rd district{{cite web |last1=Sneve |first1=Joe |title=South Dakota lawmaker kicks off primary challenge against Rep.
